contracts.protection_obligation: The clinical-trials agent's patient-facing reply must not carry a trial ref or NCT number that its tools did not return this conversation, and used_trial_refs must be limited to trials fetched this turn AND mentioned in the message; enforce_citations is registered as the agent's output validator so unverified citations are stripped and identifier-inventing replies are replaced by a fallback before the reply is delivered to the patient.
scope_limits: Kept citations are turn-scoped (must be in ctx.deps.fetched_trials AND mentioned); hallucination detection is conversation-scoped via deps.known_refs/known_ncts built from message history (guards.py:179-206; chat_service.py:117-118).
Only trial refs and NCT numbers are enforced by this guard; other unverified content in the reply is not covered.
